text:
DeployBot: alerting: embeddings route p95 increased 28% vs baseline after rollout of v3.6.1. auto-revert score=0.7 :warning:
Alex H: saw it, thanks. which customer cohorts affected?
DeployBot: impact: dedicated-pool-3 (3 tenants), hosted 0. error-rate unchanged, quality downgrade on embed similarity tests.
Sara P: hmm can we do a soft unwind (stop sending new traffic to v3.6.1 for embeddings) and pin to v3.6.0 for those tenants?
Mike L: agreed. Dedicated customers are on contracts — need comms before any automatic revert.
Emma R: I can draft a short release-note blurb + customer note. if we pin, add a note about expected improvements and upcoming follow-up.
Alex H: procedural question: do we let autorevert proceed or intervene manually? DeployBot flagged medium confidence.
Sara P: manual for this one. deploybot's confidence too low given SLA. we'll do manual rollback for dedicated-pool-3 and leave hosted alone.
Mike L: runbook step: pin version, then rollback, then smoke test embeddings similarity on canary tenant. who will own?
Alex H: I'll own pin+rollback. Emma will own comms. Sara will coordinate QA smoke.
Emma R: comms draft: "We observed a regression in embedding similarity for a subset of dedicated tenants after the recent model update. We are reverting those tenants to v3.6.0 and will follow up with post-mortem." ok? :thumbsup:
DeployBot: recommended commands:
```
redwood release pin v3.6.0 --targets=dedicated-pool-3
redwood deploy rollback --to v3.6.0 --scope=dedicated-pool-3
```
Alex H: executing pin now. will post status.
OncallBot: maintenance window note: current change window open until 23:00 UTC. if rollback crosses the window, notify customers and ops.
Alex H: pinned — `release pin` succeeded. initiating rollback in 2m.
Sara P: standing by for smoke results.
Alex H: rollback done, smoke tests: similarity delta back within 1.5% on canary tenant.
Emma R: sending customer note now (short, non-technical). will also update release notes and ops doc.
Mike L: please file a postmortem ticket and tag legal if any SLA credits are likely.
Alex H: created PM-4521 and assigned to eng-ml + infra. link: https://pm.internal/4521
Sara P: follow-up: schedule a re-test with quantized build (v3.6.1-q) in staging before we consider re-rollout.
DeployBot: logging: manual rollback executed by Alex H, reason: embedding quality regression, auto-revert suppressed.
Emma R: nice quick exec team. thanks all. :clap:
Alex H: thanks everyone — closing thread after postmortem lands.
